name: Storytime with Mrs. Claus at Fairchild
venue: Gift Shop Fireplace, Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden
when_note: Select days: November 29 and December 13, 20, 21, 22 and 24, at 11 AM, 12:30 PM and 2 PM
cost: Included with garden admission, adults from $24.95, ages 3 to 11 $11.95
paras: Fairchild Tropical Botanic Garden schedules Storytime with Mrs. Claus at the Gift Shop Fireplace on select days. Mrs. Claus reads her favorite holiday stories to families gathered around the fireplace.
Readings are at 11 AM, 12:30 PM and 2 PM on November 29 and December 13, 20, 21, 22 and 24, according to the garden.

The storytime is included with admission to A Very Merry Garden. Adult tickets start at $24.95, seniors 65 and over pay $17.95, children ages 3 to 11 pay $11.95, children 2 and under are free and Fairchild members get in free with a login.
The garden is open daily from 10 AM to 5 PM with free parking, and every child needs a ticket.
tip: Pick the 11 AM reading if you also want time for Reindeer Games in the Children's Garden, which starts at 11 AM on weekends.

name: Reindeer Games and Holiday Crafts at Fairchild
venue: Children's Garden and Gift Shop craft table
when_note: Weekends and December 21 to 24, 11 AM to 3 PM
cost: Garden admission from $24.95 adult, $11.95 ages 3 to 11; craft kits sold separately
paras: Fairchild's holiday season adds kids' activities around the garden through December 24. Reindeer Games in the Children's Garden run from 11 AM to 2 PM on weekends and December 24.

Craft kits for Gingerbread Pal Decorating and Paint Your Own Nutcracker are sold separately from admission and are limited. They are offered from 11 AM to 3 PM on weekends and every day from December 21 to 24, with the nutcracker painting at the Gift Shop craft table.
Daily extras include Letters to Santa, with a letter picked up at the Gift Shop and dropped in Santa's mailbox in the Children's Garden, and a Hot Cocoa Bar at the Bistro.
Garden admission includes A Very Merry Garden decor. NightGarden tickets are sold separately.
tip: Craft kits are limited and sold separately, so buy one early in the day.

name: Holiday Elf Gingerbread Workshop at IKEA Miami
paras: IKEA Miami invites IKEA Family members to decorate their own VINTERSAGA Gingerbread Elves at a free workshop on Friday, December 11, 2026 from 6 to 7 PM. The workshop is held at the Swedish Restaurant.

Space is limited to 100 children ages 3 to 12. IKEA asks families to RSVP for each child, with up to 2 children per IKEA Family membership, and parents must stay with their children for the whole workshop.
Craft kits are offered while supplies last, with a limit of two per membership. Signing up requires logging in to an IKEA Family account, which IKEA lets families create on its site.
IKEA notes the recipe may contain dairy and gluten, and it points families to the ingredient packaging for allergen details.
tip: Create your IKEA Family account before the workshop date, since the sign-up needs a login.

name: Christmas Family Ball in Aventura
when_note: Sunday, December 20, 12 PM Russian-language show and 6 PM English-language show
paras: ZKIDS Show brings the Christmas Family Ball to the Hilton Miami Aventura on December 20, 2026, with a 12 PM performance in Russian and a 6 PM performance in English.

The organizer describes a 90-minute immersive Christmas show with storybook characters, a bubble show, magic and illusions, circus artists and acrobats, a ballet performance and live Christmas music. The English-language ball features Santa Claus and Mrs. Claus.

Doors open one hour before each show for a pre-show with photo zones, Santa's Post Office and character experiences. Treats and drinks are sold at select locations, and holiday gifts are an optional extra purchase.

The organizer recommends the show for children ages 2 to 12, welcomes all ages and encourages festive attire. Tickets are non-refundable and non-exchangeable, and children under 2 may attend free without a seat.
tip: Arrive an hour before curtain to enjoy the pre-show activities.
